AGES: 14\+

COST: $35/1 event or $45/2 events

REGISTRATION DEADLINE: January 31

REGISTER ONLINE

We’ll have Xbox and Nintendo Switch consoles available, along with plenty of opportunities to connect with friends and fellow gamers. Enjoy free snacks and drinks throughout the event to keep you fueled for the action.

Come play, compete, and socialize at CTRL Play. We can’t wait to see you there!

This FREE event is for GRADES 9-12
